topic: Divergence and Curl: Understanding Vector Fields

sections.title: Introduction: The Flow of a Fluid
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign vectors to space points.
Fluid flow serves as our core metaphor.
Velocity arrows illustrate direction and speed.
animations: Fade in a smooth vector field representing fluid flow using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight a small region with circular flow. (Color: #FF00FF)
Animate tracer particles moving through the vector field using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particles.svg]. (Color: #00FFFF)

sections.title: Divergence: Source and Sink
lecture_lines: Divergence measures spreading at a point.
Positive divergence acts as a source.
Negative divergence acts as a sink.
animations: Display a point source where vectors point outward using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/faucet.svg]. (Color: #FF0000)
Display a point sink where vectors point inward using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drain.svg]. (Color: #0000FF)
Flash the divergence formula at the source/sink locations. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: Curl: The Rotation Factor
animations: Show a paddle wheel [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/whirlpool.svg] in the vector field rotating. (Color: #00FF00)

sections.title: Synthesis: The 'Nabla' Operator
lecture_lines: The del operator provides universal tools.
animations: Introduce the nabla symbol (∇) with scalar field. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] (Color: #FFFFFF)

Show nabla cross product with vector field (curl). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] (Color: #00FF00)
